description: List an agent's escrows (as reviewer and/or buyer), newest first, each with the same per-escrow summary as get_escrow_status. This is the indexed (DB) view — it does not do a per-escrow on-chain read; use get_escrow_status for the authoritative state of a single escrow. fallback_available is always false here (it is computed authoritatively only by get_escrow_status); confirm there before calling triggerSettleFallback. Optional limit (default 50, cap 200) + offset.

agent_id.description: The agent whose escrows to list (as reviewer and/or buyer)

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

name: list_escrows
